title: Inactive retained-state controls: draft cancellation, target identity, populated filters, time range and sorting

excluded_stills.reason: Failed automation preparation. The custom range did not apply; not product-behavior evidence.

geometry_convention: Zero-based half-open [left, top, right, bottom). Integer crops and solid opaque RGB masks only. No scaling, blur, reconstructed UI, or annotations.
evidence_medium: Direct still screenshots only. No continuous foreground-video claim.
scope: Read-only retained-view controls on INACTIVE sessions and DISABLED logpoints. Viewing-stream pause/play did not resume capture. No newly confirmed product finding is claimed.
timestamp_limit: Displayed UI event-list times are retained as shown and must not be substituted for independently verified snapshot execution times. No payload execution timestamp is visible in this pack.
privacy: Private account, person/avatar, service, session, repository, probe-ID, and snapshot-ID identities are cropped or masked wherever present. Preserved SOURCE_* and B_ONLY_ISOLATED strings are synthetic test-case message labels, not private account or snapshot identifiers.

contextual_outcomes_not_proven_by_stills.F14: Cancel discarded an existing inline draft; inline Escape left a draft open until Cancel; Back left the editor and Forward restored the saved definition; refresh discarded the draft. Closing a populated new-logpoint modal and reopening showed blank File/Line with service/environment retained; modal Escape closed it. These checks occurred while disabled, without Save/Apply or a warning.
contextual_outcomes_not_proven_by_stills.F15: The existing-target popover exposed targeting-tag editing, but no editable service/environment/location control. Alternate creation was not executed.
contextual_outcomes_not_proven_by_stills.B05: Recorded populated-list transitions were service A:1 result; service B:2; service B plus staging:2; nonmatching service-option search with actual list query unchanged; All services plus staging:6; fully cleared:6. Only staging existed, and no Version filter was exposed.
contextual_outcomes_not_proven_by_stills.F17: The verified five-minute interval excluded retained events; pause/play changed the viewing stream only; one-hour restoration returned historical events. Explicit descending and ascending ordering were tested. Separate identity inspection found the same selected snapshot after refresh and 18 rendered event IDs with 18 unique IDs. Ascending reset to default descending after refresh. No resumed capture or new product finding is claimed.
